critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated scans report no confirmed WCAG violations, no touch-target violations, and no viewport overflow (1440/768/390 px). The evidence toggle is a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. However, color contrast remains seriously incomplete for 20 vault nodes at every viewport because gradient/obscured backgrounds prevented measurement, including headings, body copy, labels, badges, and the toggle. No keyboard traversal, activation, focus-order/focus-visibility, or reduced-motion test evidence was supplied, so these required areas cannot be treated as passing.
critique.fix: Measure rendered contrast against the actual composited backgrounds and correct every failure to WCAG AA, especially muted zinc text and 10–12 px labels. Add Playwright proof for full keyboard-only operation, logical focus order, visible focus, and toggle activation/state. Test prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and verify that decorative/transition motion is disabled or minimized. Re-run these checks at all three viewports while preserving the verified touch targets and zero overflow.
